passives.name: Unstable Earth
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage dealt to enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_16] at the start of each turn. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from attacks other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by [Buff_V_4076005_12_8_1]. Reduces damage taken from non-Defender enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_6_6] and fully reduces Critical Hit Chance. At the start of battle, inflicts Shocked, Bleeding, and Poisoned on the caster and all enemies for 9 turns. These effects ignore the target's Immunity. When an enemy is defeated, removes all debuffs and fully recovers Health. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Earth enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them. Cursed/fixed damage taken by the Boss does not exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
